title: Rename val_to_str_wmem -> val_to_str
description:
val_to_str now requires a wmem allocator scope to remove the need for wmem_packet_scope within the old version

Also update the documentation of val_to_str examples to include pinfo->pool memory allocator

notes.body:
added 7 commits
  • cb7f3370...9bf4e798 - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 84799be2 - Rename val_to_str_wmem -> val_to_str
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20937/diffs?diff_id=1460507989&start_sha=cb7f3370d7455eb7128a7b2caee4fd7dae250a22)

commits_data.title: Rename val_to_str_wmem -> val_to_str
commits_data.message:
Rename val_to_str_wmem -> val_to_str

val_to_str now requires a wmem allocator scope to remove the need for wmem_packet_scope within the old version

Also update the documentation of val_to_str examples to include pinfo->pool memory allocator
